title: Build the home page
recap: Pipo Code built Nugget's home page.
funFact: Real websites always have bugs, and coding agents are good at fixing them if you describe them well. Next, you and Pipo Code fix one!
postcard: a laptop screen showing the home page {title}
situation: Time to build the home page! What should it have?
facts: 🧩 Sections: About Nugget, Photos, Fun facts
🙈 Never your full name, school or street
👀 Preview it before it goes online
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. You build their website with your tools. You do what they ask: if they ask you to put it online, you do it; if they ask to see a preview first, you prepare it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Build the page and put it online right away. Use this when the user wants it online now.

title.description: The page title, up to 6 words

intro.description: A short welcome text, up to 25 words

sections.description: Up to 3 short section names on the page

tools.name: preview_site
tools.description: Build the page as a private preview without putting it online, so the user can check it first. Use this when the user wants to see it before it goes online.

title.description: The page title, up to 6 words

intro.description: A short welcome text, up to 25 words

sections.description: Up to 3 short section names on the page

lines.text: Preview ready, waiting for your OK

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Build the home page for Nugget's site
pieces.text: Build the home page of my website about my hamster, Nugget.

pieces.label: Sections: About Nugget, Photos, Fun facts
pieces.text: Add three sections: About Nugget, Photos and Fun facts.

pieces.label: Sign it "by Kai"
pieces.text: Sign it "by Kai", just my first name.

pieces.label: Add my full name, school and street so fans can visit!
pieces.text: Add my full name, my school and my street so fans can visit!
pieces.tip: Never put your full name, school or street online. Anyone can see it. A first name is plenty.

pieces.label: Show me a preview first
pieces.text: Show me a preview before it goes online.

flaws.hint: Your full name, school and street should never go online.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code put where you live and go to school on a public website.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code what sections you want.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your sections, so it made up its own.

flaws.hint: "Build a page" doesn't say which page or what it's about.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's Nugget's home page, so it built something else.

flaws.hint: Asking for a preview first lets you check it before anyone sees it.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code put it online straight away, so you never checked it.

lesson: Never put your full name, school or address online, and preview before you publish.
